values.quote: creates a trail of mist in its wake which lasts 8 seconds

values.meaning: Stealth/bonus-speed regain lockout after attacking or casting
values.quote: preventing Viego from gaining them again for 1 second, increased to 2 seconds if he attacked a large monster
values.binNote: Wiki states 1s / 2s vs large monster; bin RestealthTime is 0.6 and RestealthTimeAfterHittingLargeMonster is 1.5, both disagreeing with the wiki's quoted values.

mechanics.claim: Casting a basic attack or an ability breaks camouflage and removes the bonus movement speed, and prevents Viego from regaining them for a duration (extended if a large monster was attacked); the duration refreshes on subsequent attacks/casts.
mechanics.quote: Declaring a basic attack or casting an ability will break the camouflage and remove the bonus movement speed, preventing Viego from gaining them again for 1 second, increased to 2 seconds if he attacked a large monster. This duration refreshes on subsequent attacks and ability casts.

mechanics.claim: Attacking does not remove the bonus attack speed granted while inside the mist, only the movement speed and camouflage.
mechanics.quote: While inside the mist, Viego gains bonus attack speed. If he does not attack or cast abilities, he also gains bonus movement speed and camouflage.

mechanics.claim: Harrowed Path can be cast during the cast time of any ability or spell.
mechanics.quote: '''Viego''' can cast ''Harrowed Path'' during the cast time of any ability or spell.

mechanics.claim: The cooldown begins only after the mist effect ends, not on cast.
